d.d: The smallest letter or stroke of any writing; an iota.
A small, or the smallest, amount of a thing; a bit, a whit.
d.x: He didn’t care a jot for his work.

d.d: A brief and hurriedly written note.
Chiefly followed by down: to write (something) quickly; to make a brief note of (something).
d.x: Tell me your order so I can jot it down.

d.d: To jerk or jolt (something); to jog.
A traditional popular dance of the Iberian peninsula with regional variations.
The music to which this dance is set, normally of 3/4 or 6/8 time.
